auth.notes: The workflow creates a fresh user through the UI, then signs in with that user to reach onboarding step one.

input.note: Capture a newly created mobile user's onboarding dialog where the action row and content can overflow horizontally.

steps: Create a brand-new local user through the UI
Sign in with that user on the same viewport
Wait for the onboarding dialog to appear at step one
Capture the resulting mobile UI state and evidence bundle

mustPass: The new user can sign up and sign in through the local app
The onboarding dialog is visible on iPhone 13
The onboarding action buttons stay inside the viewport without overlap
The page has no horizontal overflow and the proof bundle is complete

assertions.name: logout button is within the mobile viewport
next button is within the mobile viewport
logout button uses mobile touch width
next button uses mobile touch width
onboarding action buttons do not overlap
onboarding step one does not introduce horizontal overflow
no unexpected console errors appear during onboarding verification

expectedFailures: next button uses mobile touch width
